**Selecting bill-update formula**

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module ticket_machine #(
    parameter ON  = 1'b1,
    parameter OFF = 1'b0
) (
    input  clk, clear, ten, twenty,
    output reg ready, dispense, return_sig, bill
);

    localparam RDY    = 6'b000001,
               DISP   = 6'b000010,
               RTN    = 6'b000100,
               BILL10 = 6'b001000,
               BILL20 = 6'b010000,
               BILL30 = 6'b100000;

    reg [5:0] State, NextState;
    wire bill_next;

    // Determine whether the destination state is a bill state.
    // In particular, ten retains priority over twenty.
    assign bill_next = ((State == RDY) && (ten || twenty)) ||
                       (State == BILL10) ||
                       ((State == BILL20) && (ten || !twenty)) ||
                       ((State == BILL30) && !ten && !twenty);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (clear) begin
            State <= RDY;
            bill <= OFF;
        end else begin
            State <= NextState;
            bill <= bill_next ? ON : OFF;
        end
    end

    always @* begin
        ready = OFF;
        dispense = OFF;
        return_sig = OFF;
        case (State)
            RDY: ready = ON;
            DISP: dispense = ON;
            RTN: return_sig = ON;
            default: begin
                ready = OFF;
                dispense = OFF;
                return_sig = OFF;
            end
        endcase
    end

    always @* begin
        case (State)
            RDY: begin
                if (ten)
                    NextState = BILL10;
                else if (twenty)
                    NextState = BILL20;
                else
                    NextState = RDY;
            end
            BILL10: begin
                if (ten)
                    NextState = BILL20;
                else if (twenty)
                    NextState = BILL30;
                else
                    NextState = BILL10;
            end
            BILL20: begin
                if (ten)
                    NextState = BILL30;
                else if (twenty)
                    NextState = DISP;
                else
                    NextState = BILL20;
            end
            BILL30: begin
                if (ten)
                    NextState = DISP;
                else if (twenty)
                    NextState = RTN;
                else
                    NextState = BILL30;
            end
            DISP: NextState = RDY;
            RTN: NextState = RDY;
            default: NextState = RDY;
        endcase
    end
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The measured worst path is a state flip-flop through the three-input bill decode OR to the bill output. The OR contributes 0.40 ns of the reported 0.70 ns arrival time. The next reported register-to-register path already has only 0.08 ns more slack, so removing the output decode alone does not imply a large overall WNS gain.",
  "rewrite": "Register bill directly using a factored destination-state predicate, while retaining the original state transitions and combinational decoding of the other outputs. The bill register updates on the same edge as State, so it represents the newly entered state's bill output rather than adding an output pipeline cycle. Its synchronous clear value matches RDY.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Unmeasured candidate. This removes the combinational OR from the bill output path, but adds a bill-register input path that must be checked by STA. If that new path is sufficiently short and other paths remain unchanged, the reported 9.38 ns register-to-register slack would become the next limit, approximately 0.08 ns above baseline WNS. Actual WNS and non-regression of TNS require EDA confirmation.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Adds one logical bill flip-flop and destination-state predicate logic, potentially sharing terms with the existing transition logic. Available area headroom is 25.27424 um2; fitting within the 278.01664 um2 cap is not established without mapping. Reject this candidate if mapped area exceeds the cap or setup metrics fail the objective.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the top interface, parameter declarations and defaults, positive-edge clock, synchronous active-high clear, and output latency. The bill predicate covers every original state transition, including ten=twenty=1 with ten priority. Arbitrary later clear assertions synchronously enter RDY and clear bill. Equivalence is intended under the fixed startup contract against the frozen original, with no added assumptions; pre-reset uninitialized behavior is not claimed equivalent. Formal equivalence and timing/area validation remain required."
}
